data.title: 小木曾雪菜 · 写给朋友的卡片
data.description: 桌上摊着几张空白卡片。雪菜写完一句，拿起其中一张端详，确认字迹没有写错。
data.action: holding a handwritten card above the table
data.promptProse: At a tidy wooden bedroom desk under the cozy golden cone of a desk lamp, Setsuna reads a handwritten letter with blushing cheeks and shining eyes. Colored gel pens, delicate stationery envelopes, and framed school festival photos surround her hands, while soft night rain patters against the darkened window.
